candidates: When adding or migrating Sphinx Gallery tutorials (under `examples/tutorials/`), verify that computationally expensive operations use performance-optimal settings, since gallery scripts are executed during every documentation build. For GPAW calculations in particular, prefer `mode='pw'` over `mode='fd'` unless finite-difference mode is essential to the tutorial's subject matter, and avoid specifying `eigensolver='cg'` unless required — both choices can substantially reduce build time without sacrificing result accuracy.
